 Powering America's Clean and Reliable Energy Future
 CONSTELLATION 
 In the Spotlight 
 Explore the latest news and insights that highlight how Constellation is helping shape the energy landscape.  
 DATA ECONOMY
 August 28, 2026 
 Joe Dominguez Named to TIME100 AI 2026 List 
 The TIME100 AI 2026 list recognizes the world's most influential people in AI. The honor highlights Constellation's work to connect data economy customers with 24/7 nuclear energy, including our historic effort to restart the Crane Clean Energy Center. 
 INVESTORS
 August 06, 2026 
 Constellation Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results 
 Constellation Energy Corporation reported its financial results for the second quarter of 2026. 
 CORPORATE
 August 05, 2026 
 Constellation Announces Board Chairman Transition, New Board Appointment 
 CEO Joe Dominguez to serve as Board Chairman and MassMutual's Roger Crandall appointed as an Independent Director 
 SUSTAINABILITY
 June 29, 2026 
 Constellation's 2026 Sustainability Report 
 This year's report details our strategies, goals and initiatives to address key sustainability issues across our entire value chain and operations. 
 GENERATION
 June 25, 2026 
 License Renewals Filed for Ginna & Nine Mile Point Unit 1 
 Maintaining nuclear fleet will save New Yorkers $50 billion and sustain reliable emissions-free power amid rising demand. 
 ABOUT US 
 Leading the Way in Energy 
 Constellation is the nation's largest producer of clean, reliable energy and the largest private-sector energy producer in the world. We power homes, communities and businesses across a wide range of industries. 
 Read More About Us 
 55 GW 
 generating capacity from nuclear, natural gas, oil, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities 
 16,500 
 passionate and committed employees 
 ~10% 
 of the nation's clean energy generated by our fleet 
 ~2.5M 
 customer accounts served 
 80% 
 of Fortune 100 companies rely on us for their energy needs 
 STRATEGY
 Charting a Path Forward 
 Constellation powers America's energy future by expanding its clean, reliable generation fleet and offering sustainable solutions to serve customers and communities. 
 Learn More 
 PURPOSE & VALUES 
 Light the Way to a  Brilliant Tomorrow   for All 
 Constellation is committed to living our purpose every day through shared values that guide our work and benefit our customers, our communities and the nation. 
 Learn More 
 OUR IMPACT
 Managing our Climate Impacts
 We are dedicated to operating our businesses in a socially responsible and sustainable manner.
